messages:
rachel: Quick sync: GatewayWorks marketplace listing + partner HW SKU needs final owners. Were T-48h before embargo.

tom: Ill take SI validation and the integration run. Planning a 30m slot tomorrow 09:30 PT.

anika: Marketing copy almost done. Ill push final copy to /staging by 08:00 PT tomorrow. Need hero image from partner.

marc: GatewayWorks sent initial assets to s3://gatewayworks/staging/pack-472 but hero is lower res. I asked for hi-res and a 1-sentence partner quote.

rachel: Embargo: 2026-05-12T16:00:00Z. Assets + legal signoff required T-24h. Non-negotiable.

tom: SI runbook (short):
```
- checkout release/gatewayworks
- deploy connector v1.5.2
- smoke: ./ci/smoke.sh --sku GW-EDGE
- verify: tail -n 100 /var/log/redwood/connector.log | grep "handshake ok"
```
If firmware mismatch -> publish listing with "integration pending" badge.

anika: Accept low-res for preview. Final must be retina 2x. Ill tag images needing replacement.

deploy-bot: preview-check started (job 10012)
deploy-bot: preview-check passed 44c links ok, meta tags present

marc: Partner replied: high-res hero and quote will arrive by 07:30 PT tomorrow.

rachel: Two action items before green: 1) @marc confirm CDN path; 2) @tom confirm SI slot reserved and GPU for load test.

tom: Slot reserved 09:30 PT, reserving 2 GPUs for 15m warm-up then 30m test. Ill post results here.

anika: Pushed copy to staging. Will update after hero arrives.

rachel: If no major blockers by 10:00 PT tomorrow we mark as launch-ready and schedule dry-run at 11:00 PT. Document tests in Partnerships/Marketplace/GatewayWorks/launch-playbook.md.

marc: Uploaded hero to https://cdn.redwood.example/partners/gatewayworks/472/hero_2x.png and shared partner quote.

tom: Integration run complete 44d smoke + deploy success, handshake ok, noted one non-critical warning logged. Posting screenshots.

rachel: Excellent. Legal approved the quote, marketing approved copy. Marking this thread as launch-ready pending final approvals. Thanks team :thumbsup:
